svg.aria-label: 3 circles on the equator of a tilted sphere — 4-segment cubic Bezier projection
svg.text: Circles on a tilted sphere — 4-bezier cubic projection
3 markers on the equator (120° apart). Each marker is a 4-segment cubic Bezier — 12 points per keyframe instead of 24.
The Bezier curves are smooth between samples, so SMIL interpolation stays a continuous ellipse-shape, not a polygon.
